decision: Keep all experimental flags off. These screens have not established a sustained fresh120 improvement. Recommended allocation reduces conversion/completion and estimated latency, but its first live screen delivered fewer fresh frames. Repeat controlled tests before promotion.
limitations: Three15-second sequential stationary captures per group, not sustained gameplay or opticalFPS/MTP.
ALVR latency is an estimate, not optical measurement or direct network RTT.
19 color activation remains unknown: Error-only mirrored logging filters both info and warning.21 native initialization diagnostics bypass that filter.

Recommended GPU-only AHB CPU dumps differ despite successful lock; CPU readability was never requested. Do not use those dumps as pixel acceptance. Actual GLES/OpenXR screenshots were inspected and had correct eye mapping/upright colored chart; absolute GPU reference and moving-head acceptance remain unverified.
